strengths: Provides the most specific ontology-valid label supported by direct radial glia markers: FABP7, VIM, SOX2, SLC1A3, TTYH1, HOPX, ID4, HES1, EMX2, ARX.
Consistent with enriched glial lineage terms: gliogenesis, glial cell differentiation, negative regulation of neuron differentiation.
weaknesses: Top1 composite label conflates radial glial cell with neural progenitor cell, which are non-hierarchical in the frozen ontology.
Top-k list contains unrelated retinal ganglion and immune candidates despite strong radial glia evidence.

strengths: Correctly recognizes glial identity, supported by glial cell differentiation/gliogenesis enrichment and markers such as SLC1A3, CRYAB, QKI, PLP1.
weaknesses: Top1 glial cell is an ancestor of the more specific supported radial glial cell; the in-house method itself ranks radial glial cell higher (0.925 vs 0.6).
Less informative than the supported descendant label.

strengths: Identifies the general neural progenitor character using SOX2, VIM, HES1, HES4 and stem cell population maintenance terms.
weaknesses: Neural progenitor cell is non-hierarchical to radial glial cell in the frozen ontology; the shared progenitor program does not favor this branch over radial glia.
Ignores the glial-specific enrichment (gliogenesis, glial cell differentiation, astrocyte/oligodendrocyte differentiation) that supports the radial glial identity.

supporting: Direct DEGs: FABP7, VIM, SOX2, SLC1A3, TTYH1, HOPX, ID4, HES1, EMX2, ARX support radial glial cell identity.

Enrichment observations: gliogenesis, glial cell differentiation, negative regulation of neuron differentiation, stem cell population maintenance, oligodendrocyte differentiation, astrocyte differentiation.
conflicting: Neural progenitor cell (CL:0011020) is non-hierarchical to radial glial cell in the frozen ontology; only shared progenitor markers (SOX2, VIM, HES1) support it, without branch-specific evidence.
In-house top1 glial cell (CL:0000125) is an ancestor of the more specific supported radial glial cell.
